title: AAV9-ASAH1 intracisterna magna Gene Therapy (GNT0009) in Patients with Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Progressive Myoclonic Epilepsy (SMA - PME)
official: Phase 1/2 Open-Label Trial to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Biological Activity, and Clinical Efficacy of intracisterna Magna administration of an AAV9 Vector Encoding Human ASAH1 (GNT0009) in Patients with Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Progressive Myoclonic Epilepsy (SMA-PME)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of a single ICM administration of GNT0009 in patients with SMA-PME
conditions: Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Progressive Myoclonic Epilepsy (SMA-PME)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female participants
2. Documented genetically SMA-PME diagnosis
3. Up-to-date immunization status according to the French national vaccination schedule (2025), including recommended vaccines for age and/or risk groups, notably: hepatitis B, measles-mumps-rubella (MMR), varicella*, hepatitis A (in at-risk populations), Neisseria meningitidis (ACWY + B), Streptococcus pneumoniae, seasonal influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) where indicated
4. Ability of the participant and/or legal representatives to confirm the adherence to the clinical trial visit schedule and all protocol requirements
5. Effective contraception
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of Farber disease
2. Positive serology consistent with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection or evidence of active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
3. Concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 and/or P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inducers or inhibitors
4. Severe intellectual disability (e.g., intellectual quotient [IQ] < 50)
5. Gross Motor Function Classification in Metachromatic Leukodystrophy (GMFC-MLD) score of 6 (loss of any locomotion as well as loss of any head and trunk control).
6. Presence of a severe concomitant medical condition or clinically significant abnormal laboratory / imaging findings that, in the opinion of the investigator, may interfere with the course of SMA-PME or place the participant at increased risk of severe complications
7. Hepatic dysfunction Grade ≥3 as defined by CTCAE criteria
8. Severely impaired pulmonary function (e.g., FVC <30% predicted) and/or respiratory insufficiency requiring either of the following: (a) non-invasive ventilation for >16 hours per day, or (b) invasive mechanical ventilation via tracheostomy
9. History or evidence of increased intracranial pressure, hydrocephalus, or need for CSF diversion
10. Coagulation disorders or clinically significant abnormalities in coagulation parameters that increase the risk of bleeding associated with ICM administration
11. Presence of any permanent or non-MRI–compatible implants or devices (e.g., metal braces) that preclude safe MRI assessment
